raw_signal: AI-native email clients are emerging because inboxes now contain human conversations, SaaS notifications, AI-agent outputs, and workflow signals in one overloaded place.
buyer: Startup founders, operators, salespeople, consultants, newsletter-heavy creators, and AI builders drowning in email.
pain: Important opportunities are buried inside email noise. The inbox is no longer just a communication tool; it is an unstructured signal feed.
why_now: AI agents, SaaS notifications, and automated workflows are increasing inbox volume and complexity, creating demand for classification and extraction tools.
first_product: A manual Gmail paste-in tool that extracts business opportunities, buyer pain, product ideas, and content angles from selected newsletters and emails.
price: $9-$29/month, or $19 one-time for an inbox signal report.
distribution: Product Hunt, X, Indie Hackers, Gmail power-user communities, AI builder communities.
lead_magnet_angle: Find 10 business ideas hiding in your inbox.
content_angle: Your inbox is not email anymore. It is a business signal database.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion converts Gmail newsletters and startup emails into AI business opportunities and build prompts.
